description.value: Culture Shock is a café, art gallery, and gift shop located in Alert Bay on Cormorant Island, a small community accessible by ferry from Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island. The shop carries local jewellery, clothing, accessories, books, and gifts alongside a café, making it a natural gathering point in a community with limited services. Alert Bay is renowned for its 'Namgis First Nations cultural heritage and is a common destination for cyclists and kayakers exploring the northern Vancouver Island region.

raw_osm.description: It has also an integrated gift shop
raw_osm.name: Culture Shock

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active business at cultureshocklife.com; the contact page title 'Culture Shock Café, Gallery & Gifts | Alert Bay, BC' confirms the café component and location, consistent with OSM's shop=coffee tag. The website content is dominated by a Shopify currency-selector dropdown and provides no detail on cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms), so all amenity fields must be null. A hours discrepancy exists: OSM shows Mon–Sat 10:00–18:00 and Sun 12:00–17:00, while the website shows summer hours Tue–Sun 10–4:30.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Culture Shock Café is one of the few food-service options in Alert Bay, a ferry-accessed island community that is a notable destination for touring cyclists; its inclusion provides genuine value for cyclists planning this route.
